import heapq
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    N = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    M = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    X = int(data[idx]); idx += 1

    forward = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    backward = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for _ in range(M):
        u = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        v = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        forward[u].append(v)
        backward[v].append(u)

    INF = float('inf')
    # dist[v][p]: p=0 means original orientation, p=1 means reversed
    dist = [[INF, INF] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dist[1][0] = 0
    pq = [(0, 1, 0)]

    while pq:
        d, v, p = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if d > dist[v][p]:
            continue
        if v == N:
            print(d)
            return
        # Move along an edge (cost 1)
        adj = forward[v] if p == 0 else backward[v]
        nd = d + 1
        for u in adj:
            if nd < dist[u][p]:
                dist[u][p] = nd
                heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, u, p))
        # Reverse all edges (cost X)
        np = 1 - p
        nd2 = d + X
        if nd2 < dist[v][np]:
            dist[v][np] = nd2
            heapq.heappush(pq, (nd2, v, np))

    print(min(dist[N][0], dist[N][1]))
